nodes.description: Address of the current contract owner, set in the Owned constructor from msg.sender.
Pending owner address used by the two-step ownership transfer.
Public ERC20 token symbol 'BLPD'.
Public ERC20 token name 'BlackPyramid'.
Public token decimals, set to 18.
Total token supply of 3000 * 10^18 minted to the deployer address.
Mapping of account address to token balance.
Nested mapping owner => spender => allowance.
Checked addition library function with require(c >= a).
Checked subtraction library function with require(b <= a).
Checked multiplication library function with require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
Checked division library function with require(b > 0).
Owned constructor that assigns owner = msg.sender, establishing the privileged role.
onlyOwner function that stages a new owner in newOwner.
Completes ownership handover; requires msg.sender == newOwner.
Token constructor that sets metadata, total supply and the initial balance.
Returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)] using an unchecked subtraction.
Returns the balance of tokenOwner.
Transfers tokens from msg.sender to 'to' using safeSub/safeAdd.
Sets the allowance of spender for msg.sender; allows double-spend front-running.
Spends allowance of msg.sender to move tokens from 'from' to 'to'.
Returns the remaining allowance of spender for tokenOwner.
Sets allowance and then performs an external call to spender.receiveApproval.
Payable fallback that immediately reverts, refusing Ether.
onlyOwner function that performs an external ERC20 transfer of arbitrary tokens to owner.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, balance and allowance keying.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval on an attacker-supplied address.
External ERC20 transfer call on the arbitrary tokenAddress argument.
